Australian Bureau of Statistics

Attribution: Based on Australian Bureau of Statistics data.

Area profiles use the 2021 Census General Community Profile on 2021 / ASGS Edition 3 geographies. The newer map and crosswalk layers include ASGS Edition 4 (2026). Census counts remain labelled with their reference year; they are not 2026 estimates.
